say:1:1121162001:1.text: He sent a wind message a few days ago, but it was muddled and took some time for Bryon to decipher.
say:1:1121162001:1.source_cn: 他前些天传来一条风讯，但是口齿不清的样子，布莱恩分辨了...

say:2:1121162002:1.text: It roughly translates to: "Seasick. Northern wind. Life is free of worries."
say:2:1121162002:1.source_cn: “晕船。风吹向北。又及，无性命之忧。”——大意如此。

say:4:1121162004:1.text: There was no telling where Lorsan went, but at least he remembered to send word!
say:4:1121162004:1.source_cn: 也不知道他跑到哪里去了，但不管怎么说，洛桑至少记得来信了！

say:5:1121162005:1.text: As long as he's safe and sound... perhaps he's grown up a bit out there.
say:5:1121162005:1.source_cn: 无论如何，只要他平安无事就好……他在外面是不是也有些成...
